descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale, Fabricația de componente pentru industria aviatică și aerospațială și Fabricația de autovehicule
*For candidates outside Baia Mare, a relocation package will be discussed.
 For our client, a manufacturing company, we're looking for a Network Engineer with hands-on experience, ready to take a bigger role in running and improving a multi-site infrastructure. You WIll work on day-to-day operations, take ownership of incidents, and gradually get involved in design decisions.
 Why this role 
Real hands-on scope: you'll operate and improve the network, not just monitor it
Multi-site environment spanning enterprise and OT (industrial) networks
Hybrid setup: on-prem networks connected to Azure/AWS
Security-minded culture: Zero Trust, NAC, close work with the SOC
Collaboration with Cloud, Security, OT and Support teams
 What you'll work with 
 Network: LAN/WAN/WLAN, OSPF, BGP, VLAN, STP, site-to-site and remote VPN
 Security & access: NAC (ClearPass / Cisco ISE), firewalls and ACLs, incident response, Zero Trust principles
 Cloud & hybrid: Azure/AWS connectivity, hybrid VPNs
 Monitoring & tools: SNMP, NetFlow, NMS, Wireshark, root-cause analysis
 What we're looking for 
3+ years of experience in IT networking
Hands-on experience with enterprise networks (routing, switching, Wi-Fi)
Good grasp of network security fundamentals
Able to troubleshoot and resolve incidents independently, with senior support for the most complex cases
Able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical colleagues
